summary: The comments from HWC Consultants, an E-Rate and telecommunications consulting firm, address the consultant provisions of the FCC's Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking. They support treating the consulting firm as the consultant, rather than individual employees, to avoid ambiguity in registration.
